description: Use when you need an llm chat completion for summaries, extraction or classification from a cheap open model. Do not use for frontier models, tool calling or streaming. Returns JSON with a chat completion from IBM Granite 4.0 Micro on Workers AI, with token usage for 0.002 USDC per thousand tokens, up to 0.03 USDC per call (clients without upto pay the cap). Result in the same call (about 8000 ms); a status tool polls for free if it takes longer. Category: Inference. Price: US$0.03 per call. A small free demo credit covers the first calls; after that the tool returns the command that pays the call from your own wallet (AgentCash or Coinbase Agentic Wallet).

maxTokens.description: Maximum tokens to generate (1-4096, 512 when omitted); billed as requested

messages.description: Conversation so far, oldest first, e.g. [{"role": "user", "content": "Summarize: ..."}]

temperature.description: Sampling temperature (0-2), e.g. 0.2 for near-deterministic output

name: blackwood_llm_chat
title: LLM chat completion
